title: Successful acceptance child exits before pending resource recovery can complete
severity: S3: repeated invalid test attempts, no established product failure
preconditions: Exact Settings ARM run37732615934: package/browser valid; guest admitted; resource policy requires three healthy recovery samples.
reproduction: Start a guarded child; observe one unsafe CPU sample opening a pending episode.
Observe two healthy samples, then successful child exit before the third sample.
Inspect final journal: pending child exit becomes resource-invalid, exit3; recovery cannot continue although confirmation timeout is not yet exhausted.
expected: Native actions remain stopped while pending; a successful completed child retains owned lease for bounded existing recovery, with all unsafe and timeout rules preserved.
actual: Guard immediately finalizes invalid on child exit while pending, causing entire completed run to lack acceptance credit. This correctly enforced the prior conservative contract; repair improves completion coordination, not retrospective validity.
cause: Source guard child-exit path ends watch loop when CPU recovery remains pending.

transition_history.reason: Repeated Settings acceptance invalidations culminated in independently explained pending-completion boundary.
Fresh peer distinguishes one bad/two healthy samples from confirmed sustained unsafe load.
Implementer owns bounded guard completion with unchanged limits and explicit failure controls.
